🇲🇽🏭 <u>US STEEL TARIFFS RAISE MEXICAN CONSTRUCTION COSTS 3–6% — SHEINBAUM'S INFRASTRUCTURE BUILD CAUGHT IN CROSSFIRE</u>

For a decade, a man wanted for 43 enforced disappearances was living comfortably in the US. Calderón's army officers don't get persecuted by Washington — they get safe harbor. Until they don't.

She confirmed Mexico is leading the conversation on UN reform for the next 80 years, alongside other member states.

Trump's State Department calls Mexico a "narco-state." The UN calls it a moral compass. Same country, opposite mirrors. One of them is lying.

"It's not the young person's fault. It's the fault of a government that didn't generate the conditions." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Xalapa, Veracruz

🇲🇽✊ "Access to education is a right. Access to healthcare is a right. Access to dignified work is a right." Since 2018, 3.5 million young Mexicans have entered the workforce through Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro — monthly minimum wage plus IMSS health coverage, one full year of paid work experience.
